translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Mina Isireli iviloubusisi wa Koya Sinai

E mina Isireli isilavaisi Repidim e leimaisi oviloupakala Sinai. E iviloubusisi baisa wa yam makwaina kala vitouula tubukona natolula metoya tuta matutona eisilavaisi Itipita. E baisa goli ibudaisi kabosikaiwa okaikela Koya Sinai.
E Mosese imwena wa koya paila bibodasi sola Yaubada. E Guyau idou baisa matauna metoya wa koya e iluki matauna kidamwa biluki mina Isireli, matausina Yekobe tubula, kawala,
“Ka! Bogwa kugisaisi avaka yeigu Guyau lavagi baisa mina Itipita, e ammakawala yeigu layamataimi makawala natana mluveka bilupi litula metoya opinupanela, e lamaiyaimi baisa.

E, kidamwa yokomi bukukwabikuwolaigusi deli bukuvagaisi ulo kabutu, e yokomi bavigakaimi ulo tomota tatougu. E komwaidona valu watanawa baisa yeigu wala ulo vavagi, mitaga yokomi bogwa lanagaimi paila ulo tomota.
E bukukwabomaimi titoulemi baisa yeigu agumwaleta, e bukuwotitalaigusi makawala tolula yokomi.”
Mapaila Mosese ibusi metoya wa koya e idou tokugwala tomota komwaidosi iluki matausina vavagi komwaidona avaka Guyau eikaraiwogi matauna.
E komwaidosi tomota ivitakaulokaisi kawasi, “Bogwa bakavagaisi komwaidona vavagi avaka Guyau eilivala.” E Mosese ikamituli makawala baisa Guyau.

E Guyau iluki Mosese kawala, “Yeigu bamakaiam metoya wa lowalowa saina pilapopou, e tomota bilagaida tabibigatona, e metoya wa tuta matutona bivigaki bidubumaimsi goli.” Mosese iluki Guyau avaka tomota eivitakaulokaisi,
e Guyau iluki matauna kawala, “Kulokaia tomota kuluki kidamwa ibodi lagaila deli nabwaia bikikilaisi titoulesi paila tapwaroru. Komwaidosi kasi kwama biwinaisi,
e bitutulaigusi paila bugiyu. Paila yam makwaina yeigu babusi odabala Koya Sinai, e baisa komwaidosi tomota gagabila bigisaigusi.

E kusaili tula okuvalila koya bitavina bitapatu baisa tomota gala bikayupailisi. E kuluki galaga bimwenasi wa koya kaina bilosi katitaikina. Kidamwa availa bivitouula mweimwena, bukukwatumataisi wala.

Kaina bukukwabidikunaisi kainaga bukubasaisi okaiyala, e taga availa bikabikoni matauna. Karaiwaga makwaina biboda tomota deli mauna, e kasi karaiwaga makawala wala, ibodi bukukwatumataisi. Mitaga ka, avai tuta tauya bitagina, e tuta matutona goli ibodi tomota bimwenasi wa koya.”
Oluvi Mosese itobusi leima metoya wa koya, e iluki tomota bikatubaiasasi paila tapwaroru. E iwinaisi kasi kwama.
E Mosese iluki matausina kawala, “Bukukwatubaiasasi paila bugiyu, e wa tuta matutona gala bukukwanavaisi.”
Kwaitolula yam kaukwau e pilapala, kavikavila, deli lowalowa pilapopou ikayounapula odabala koya e ilagaisi tauya butula itagilulu. E komwaidosi tomota okabosikaiwa itatuvasi deli kasi kokola.
E Mosese ivisunupuloi matausina metoya okabosikaiwa mwada bibodaisi Yaubada, e itolisi okuvalila koya.
Komwaidona Koya Sinai ikuboli mseu, paila Guyau eibusi leima olopola kova. Mitaga mseu ititokaia makawala susupa wa dumia mseula, e tomota komwaidosi itatatuvasi saina siligaga.
Mitaga butula tauya isiniveka e tuvaila isisiniveka. Mosese ilivala, e ka! - Yaubada bogwa leimapu matauna metoya opilapala.
E Guyau ibusi odabala Koya Sinai e idou Mosese bilokaia odabala koya. E mapaila Mosese imwena odabala,
e Guyau iluki matauna kawala, “Ka, kubusi kula kukwatululuti tomota taga biluvipeilisi tula mwada bimaisi bigisaigusi. Kidamwa bivagaisi makawala, bidubadu bikaligasi.
Deli goli kidamwa matausina tolula bimaisi katitaikinegu ibodi bikikilaisi titoulesi. Kidamwa gala, e bogwa bamipuki matausina.”
Mosese iluki Guyau kawala, “Tomota gala gagabila bimaisi baisa, paila kukwaraiwogaimasi mwada bakadokaisi koya kwebumaboma wala, e kidamwa bakasailisi tula bitavina bitapatu.”

Mitaga Guyau ivitakaula kawala, “Kubusi kulokaia Eroni e kamitaiyu kumakaiagusi. Mitaga tolula deli tomota gala biluvipeilisi tula mwada bimakaiagusi. Kidamwa bivagaisi makawala, e bogwa bamipuki matausina.”
E Mosese ibusi ilokaia tomota e iluki avaka Guyau eilivala.
